description:
CrowdBT — joint fit of entity scores + per-annotator
reliability η. Surfaces noisy / anti-correlated raters
explicitly. Methodology audit, not a live engine. Annotators
are named by a per-ranking pseudonym, never a user id.

With `include_judges=true`, adds `judges_as_annotators`: each AI
judge's reliability η on the same scale as people's (with a 95%
interval and the share of people it is more reliable than). Item
scores come from people only, so a judge never moves them; each
person is measured against scores refitted without them.

api_key is optional on the public endpoint; on /mcp/mcp a missing
key is refused.
name: aimrank_get_crowd_bt
title: CrowdBT audit fit
